All five pages built. Each is fully self-contained with inline CSS (Google Fonts via @import), no external assets, no frameworks. Shared design system across pages: dark base with red (#ff224d) primary and yellow (#ffd23f) accent, Barlow Condensed display font, sticky topbar + animated ticker, and matching footer treatment.

Page highlights:
- **home.html**: Hero with live match card, news grid with play-button thumbnails, upcoming matches table, roster spotlight with radial-glow player cards, Twitch player + chat, sponsor row, Discord CTA strip
- **roster.html**: Team hero with stat rail, 5-card starting lineup with role tags/numbers/flags, coaching staff cards, support staff table
- **schedule.html**: Big "Every Match. Every Game." hero, game/tournament filter chips, sticky sidebar (teams + tournaments + season record), tabbed match groups, full playoffs bracket with red-highlighted Voltaic paths
- **shop.html**: Jersey hero with bobbing animated jersey graphic, countdown drop strip, category nav with counts, benefits row, product grids (jerseys, hoodies, accessories), signed collection with COA reservations
- **teams.html**: "Four Games. One Flag." hero, filter row, 4 team cards with stats/win-rate/recent form pills, trophy shelf grid, partner row

result:
All five pages built. Each is fully self-contained with inline CSS (Google Fonts via @import), no external assets, no frameworks. Shared design system across pages: dark base with red (#ff224d) primary and yellow (#ffd23f) accent, Barlow Condensed display font, sticky topbar + animated ticker, and matching footer treatment.

Page highlights:
- **home.html**: Hero with live match card, news grid with play-button thumbnails, upcoming matches table, roster spotlight with radial-glow player cards, Twitch player + chat, sponsor row, Discord CTA strip
- **roster.html**: Team hero with stat rail, 5-card starting lineup with role tags/numbers/flags, coaching staff cards, support staff table
- **schedule.html**: Big "Every Match. Every Game." hero, game/tournament filter chips, sticky sidebar (teams + tournaments + season record), tabbed match groups, full playoffs bracket with red-highlighted Voltaic paths
- **shop.html**: Jersey hero with bobbing animated jersey graphic, countdown drop strip, category nav with counts, benefits row, product grids (jerseys, hoodies, accessories), signed collection with COA reservations
- **teams.html**: "Four Games. One Flag." hero, filter row, 4 team cards with stats/win-rate/recent form pills, trophy shelf grid, partner row
